metadata.description: Shadowcat codebase skills, agents, and the skill-routing hook, sourced from the Shadowcat repo's .claude/ directory and shared with downstream consumers of the engine.

plugins.name: shadowcat-codebase
plugins.description: Plugin root is Shadowcat's .claude/ directory; only its skills/, agents/, and hooks/ subdirectories are consumed. Includes the 15 shadowcat-codebase-* subsystem orientation skills plus the git-ignored graphify skill, the coder/reviewer agent set, and the codebase-skill routing hook.
